subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “A guide explained that sound travels far underwater.”?
options: For some animals, noise can make communication harder.
The board did not make them work harder.
Most lanterns were shaped like animals or flowers.
They were also children making animals from clay.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「A guide explained that sound travels far underwater. For some animals, noise can make communication harder.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The board did not make them work harder.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Most lanterns were shaped like animals or flowers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They were also children making animals from clay.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A guide explained that sound travels far underwater. For some animals, noise can make communication harder.」，答案為「For some animals, noise can make communication harder.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「For some animals, noise can make communication harder.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
